name: phototools-cli
description: Foto-Batch-Organizer -- deterministic exiftool + ImageMagick pipeline that sorts/renames/watermarks photos by real EXIF date+GPS and builds a contact sheet, for bunsenbrenner.org demo portfolio

scripts.fixture:organize: node fixtures/generate.js && node bin/phototools.js organize fixtures/.tmp/raw --out fixtures/.tmp/sorted --watermark-text "bunsenbrenner.org . demo" --contact-sheet
